summary.zh-CN: Greptile 官方远程 MCP，查看已索引的仓库、合并请求与 Greptile 代码评审意见（只读）。由 Teloa 以 OAuth（动态客户端注册 + PKCE）授权，只申请 read scope，令牌自动刷新。需在 Greptile 平台接入目标仓库。数据经由 greptile.com 传输。
summary.en: Greptile official remote MCP: browse indexed repositories, pull/merge requests and Greptile code-review comments (read-only). Authorized by Teloa via OAuth (dynamic client registration + PKCE) requesting only the read scope, with automatic token refresh. Target repositories must be connected in Greptile. Data transits greptile.com.

description.zh-CN: 列出 Greptile 已接入的仓库
获取 PR / MR 详情与评审记录
description.en: Get a PR/MR with review records

description.zh-CN: 列出 PR / MR 评审意见
搜索 Greptile 评审意见

conditions.zh-CN: 需在 市场 > 连接 页由本人在浏览器中完成 OAuth 授权；服务器部署需在配置文件设置 oauth.publicCallbackUrl
conditions.en: The owner must complete OAuth authorization in a browser from Market > Connections; server deployments must set oauth.publicCallbackUrl in the config file

conditions.zh-CN: 官方设置文档只列 OAuth；授权服务器 auth.greptile.com 支持动态客户端注册与 PKCE S256，本机回环回调（127.0.0.1）尚未实测。只申请 read scope，目录只列出只读工具
conditions.en: Greptile setup docs list OAuth only; the authorization server auth.greptile.com supports dynamic client registration and PKCE S256, and the loopback callback (127.0.0.1) has not been tested yet. Only the read scope is requested and only read-only tools are listed

conditions.zh-CN: 数据经由 greptile.com 平台传输
